_note: The shelf. Six titles, no episodes, none of them live — they exist so the
homepage reads as a catalogue rather than as one series and a lot of black.
They are real slates rather than filler: each one is a genre this audience
already pays for, and each has the turn in the title. If any of them is
never made, taking it off the shelf is one flag in the console.

series.title: Bound to the Alpha I Betrayed
series.blurb: She testified against him. Then the pack chose her as his mate.

series.title: She Divorced Him and Bought the Company
series.blurb: He kept the house. She kept the only thing he could not replace.

series.title: The Nanny Was the Heiress
series.blurb: Two weeks before the will is read, she takes a job in her own house.

series.title: My Husband's Other Funeral
series.blurb: She buried him in March. In September, she watched him bury someone else.

series.title: Sold to the Rival Heir
series.blurb: Her father's debt came due on the morning of her sister's wedding.

series.title: The Janitor Owns the Building
series.blurb: They fired him on Friday. On Monday he signed their paychecks.
